title: Screenshot any part of your PC screen #shorts
description:
On Windows 10 and 11, press Windows + Shift + S, then drag over any area. The snip is copied, so you can paste it straight into a chat or email with Ctrl + V.

#windows #pctips #techtips #productivity #shorts

points.d: the screen dims and a toolbar appears.
it's already copied, ready to share.

fix:

and drag to snip
